content:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — flap in customer 'Lattice' Dedicated VPC peering hit again this morning, causing a short isolation window for on-prem callers. Logs point to same NAT translation race as last quarter.
incident-bot: Alert: VPC_PEERING_FLAP detected for tenant=Lattice at 2026-11-03T07:12:34Z (ticket INC-8821 created)
Aj Patel: Saw it. Connection dropped ~3m, retries handled but some inference requests timed out.
Devon Brooks: I pulled the flow logs, looks like asymmetric SNAT during route reprogramming. Same signature as INC-7064.
Priya Singh: Is the mitigation from the old postmortem (sticky SNAT rule + small routing cooldown) still applied? I thought we automated cooldown for Dedicated clusters.
Carlos Rivera: We rolled the sticky SNAT to prod for hosted clusters but not to the customer's on-prem edge — that one is manual in their bootstrap config.
Maria Chen: OK — two tracks: 1) immediate customer remediation steps, 2) platform fix to prevent recurrence for on-prem peering.
Aj Patel: Immediate: run playbook step -> set explicit SNAT rule on Lattice edge, and extend BGP flap dampening to 60s. I've created JIRA DED-4092 for the manual change and notified customer SE.
Priya Singh: Can we add a temporary route-programming cooldown in the peering controller? Even a 30s debounce would cut the window.
Devon Brooks: We can. Patch idea: controller delays applying new routes for 30s after a peer-change event, keeping session pins to existing SNAT mapping. I can prototype.
Carlos Rivera: Prototype sounds good, but need to ensure it doesn't break their failover timelines. Add a feature flag toggled per-tenant.
Aj Patel: Agreed — toggle per-tenant is required. Also need a migration plan for existing manual configs.
Maria Chen: Action items: 
- Aj: DED-4092 — customer-side SNAT + dampening applied (ETA today EOD)
- Devon: PR for controller debounce + feature flag (branch: peering/debounce-2255) (ETA 3 days)
- Priya: Add e2e test to infra-ci to simulate peering flap (ETA 1 week)
- Carlos: Coordinate with SE to schedule maintenance window with Lattice and verify on-prem bootstrap guide (ETA 2 days)
- Maria: Weekly check-in cadence established for the remediation owners until we see 30 days clean (sync every Mon 10am PT)
Aj Patel: DED-4092 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DED-4092 — I've added the runbook snippet under the issue and pinged the customer.
Devon Brooks: Quick grep dump of the core signature: ```
# flow log extract
src=10.24.7.12 dst=203.0.113.45 proto=tcp action=drop reason=SNAT_REASSIGN
```
Priya Singh: For the e2e test, I'll add a synthetic BGP flap generator in the test harness and assert session continuity >95% during a 2-minute noisy window.
Carlos Rivera: I've started a private thread with SEs at Lattice, asked for their bootstrap artifacts. They flagged an older edge appliance with limited conntrack table size. Might be contributing.
Maria Chen: Good catch. Add conntrack sizing to the remediation checklist.
Aj Patel: Also noting recurrence pattern — this is third time in ~6 months, same root cause. We should add it to the recurring incidents tracker and consider a long-term project for on-prem peering hardened defaults.
Devon Brooks: I created branch and pushed initial debounce patch: https://git.redwood.ai/peering/commit/abc123 (WIP). Needs safety tests.
Priya Singh: I'll own the CI test addition, will PR to infra-ci with a seed job named peering-flap-sim.
Carlos Rivera: SEs requested a clear rollback plan in case the debounce interacts badly with their failover. Add a CLI toggle + a quick revert doc.
Maria Chen: Updated action list with owners and ETA. We'll run the weekly Monday sync until we hit 30 days without recurrence. If we hit 2 recurrences within 90 days, escalate to a dedicated remediation sprint.
Aj Patel: Logged recurrence to tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/REC-PEER-001 — added notes + links to DED-4092, INC-8821.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-remediation-sync @channel every Mon 18:00 UTC starting 2026-11-09
Devon Brooks: FYI: my debounce patch includes metrics (peering.debounce_applied, peering.route_rejections). I'll add dashboards to the peering folder.
Priya Singh: For postmortem doc, I'll update the 'onprem-peering-playbook.md' with a checklist: conntrack sizing, SNAT sticky rule, BGP dampening, feature-flag toggle, rollback steps.
Carlos Rivera: After we confirm bootstrap artifact and conntrack fixes, schedule a 2hr maintenance with Lattice to apply permanent cfg.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Mon 10am PT. If anyone sees another flap before then, ping incident channel and escalate to oncall. :thumbsup: 
Aj Patel: Noted. Closing loop: DED-4092 in progress, PR from Devon, infra test from Priya, SE contact from Carlos.
Devon Brooks: I'll drop short notes into DED-4092 once patch hits staging.
Priya Singh: I'll add the CI job and post results.
Carlos Rivera: I'll share the customer's bootstrap doc once we get permission.
Maria Chen: End of thread — tracking under REC-PEER-001 and DED-4092.
